about: Not covered. A roommate who left and stopped paying his half. Expected: the model loads no skill and says the tool has no skill for this, and since the tool holds the lease it searches the lease on the subject (the test lease's Section 21.3, Joint and Several Liability). Until 2026-10-12 the tool stopped before the chat and printed the lease's clause itself; the model's own search_lease call takes the place of that stop page.

start.description: My roommate moved out in August without telling anyone and stopped paying his half of the rent, which is $600. I've been covering the whole thing. Can I make him pay me back? We're both on the lease.

turns.say: Can I make him pay me back
